scope: Prebuilt release executables; baseline then final sequentially, each PP/LQR one warmup plus 3 samples. Agent builds/tests idle. Host/system load otherwise uncontrolled. Full synchronous simulate wall time, not per-tick deadline or target WCET.

baseline.scope: Host wall time for complete simulate calls, including synthetic RGB/laser generation, control, plant and sink telemetry; excludes report serialization. Not solver-only CPU time, per-tick latency, hardware timing or a worst-case deadline guarantee.

final.scope: Host wall time for complete simulate calls, including synthetic RGB/laser generation, control, plant and sink telemetry; excludes report serialization. Not solver-only CPU time, per-tick latency, hardware timing or a worst-case deadline guarantee.
